result: Drop watcher records sampled lock waits and holders in bounded change-only lock-waits.jsonl; process.lockWaits summarises episodes, maximum observed age and blocked seconds by redacted query.
decisions: Use pg_locks.waitstart, falling back to state_change; scope waiters to current_database().
Four-second client, child-process and server statement timeouts; one sample at a time; failures nonfatal.
Cap the entire JSONL at 2000 records, including disappearances; continue summary sampling after the cap.
Blocked seconds count adjacent successful observations of the same wait and blocker query, excluding unknown time before/after sightings and across failures. They are sampled lower bounds.
